BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
WITH solo AS (SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN b.time ~ '^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9](:[0-5][0-9])?$' THEN ((b.date+b.time::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') + make_interval(hours=>CASE WHEN e.duration>0 THEN e.duration ELSE 2 END) END ends_at,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bookings other WHERE other.id<>b.id AND other.experience_id=b.experience_id AND other.date=b.date AND other.time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.time AND lower(other.status) IN ('paid','confirmed','completed') AND other.guests>0) other_confirmed
FROM public.bookings b LEFT JOIN public.experiences e ON e.id=b.experience_id WHERE b.is_solo_guarantee OR b.solo_guarantee_price>0)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
'ended_eligible_unresolved',count(*) FILTER(WHERE ends_at<=now() AND other_confirmed AND lower(status) IN ('paid','confirmed','completed') AND solo_guarantee_refund_status<>'refunded'),
'payout_with_unresolved',count(*) FILTER(WHERE payout_status='paid' AND (solo_guarantee_refund_status IN ('processing','pending_manual','failed') OR (ends_at<=now() AND other_confirmed AND lower(status) IN ('paid','confirmed','completed') AND solo_guarantee_refund_status<>'refunded'))),
'active_host_basis_mismatch',count(*) FILTER(WHERE lower(status) IN ('paid','confirmed','completed') AND floor(total_experience_price*0.8)<>host_payout_amount),
'active_platform_balance_mismatch',count(*) FILTER(WHERE lower(status) IN ('paid','confirmed','completed') AND amount-greatest(coalesce(refund_amount,0),solo_guarantee_refund_amount)-host_payout_amount<>platform_revenue),
'processing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE solo_guarantee_refund_status='processing'),
'pending_manual',count(*) FILTER(WHERE solo_guarantee_refund_status='pending_manual'),
'failed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE solo_guarantee_refund_status='failed'),
'unknown_new_state','N/A: P0 migration not applied',
'financial_operation_table_present',to_regclass('public.booking_solo_refund_operations') IS NOT NULL,
'avatar_authority_ledger_present',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations WHERE version='20261005082309'),
'migration_ledger',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name) ORDER BY version) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
'completion_definition_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef('public.complete_experience_booking_if_due_atomic(text)'::regprocedure))
) evidence FROM solo; COMMIT;
